description: Corpo inteiro em locação. Usa a locação como cenário fotografável, não como fundo trocável. Composição vertical 4:5 ou 3:4, câmera na altura do peito. Uso: editorial de moda em rua, ensaio de campanha em locação.

ask_before.prompt: Descreva a pessoa: idade aproximada, pele, cabelo, altura aparente, formato de corpo. Sem nome.
Duas assimetrias, uma facial e uma postural (peso mais em uma perna, ombro mais alto).
Look completo — em corpo inteiro o vestuário toma metade do quadro. Nomeie tecidos por peça.
Locação: rua, praça, corredor arquitetônico. Determina o preenchimento e a perspectiva.
Proporção. Recomendado 4:5 para editorial, 9:16 para social vertical.

scene.headline: Editorial full-body portrait on location, single subject standing

subject.vellus_hair: vellus at the jaw catches the edge of the sky fill

wardrobe.weave: flannel wool with a visible twill weave
tension_creases: vertical creases falling from the shoulder to the elbow
compression creases at the inner elbow and at the hip where the fabric folds
a slight roll where the collar meets the neck
wardrobe.drape: the wool falls with structured weight, holding broad folds rather than fluid ones

in_focus: the near eye and the near hand
out_of_focus: the far leg and the far shoulder soften progressively
the environment 10 metres out and beyond separates by depth

camera.perspective_note: 85mm on full frame at 4.5 metres holds body proportions naturally without foreshortening the near foot

optics.bokeh_character: soft rounded bokeh centred, with mild cat-eye deformation at the edges
optics.chromatic_aberration: faint magenta-green longitudinal fringe on the specular highlights at the hair edge
optics.vignetting: half a stop of mechanical vignetting in the corners

sources.elevation: 35 degrees above the horizon, high-side of the subject

lighting.shadow_direction: falls toward camera-left and slightly forward, penumbra narrow near the feet and widening across the ground
lighting.contact_shadow: the shadow of both feet meets the ground densely, opening into a soft penumbra away from the sole

catchlight.shape: a small round concentrated specular from the sun in each iris
catchlight.position: upper temporal side of the near eye
catchlight.far_eye: smaller and dimmer in the far eye, with a broad diffuse sky fill as a secondary highlight in the lower half

lighting.mixed_temperature: the 5200K sun and the 8500K sky dome diverge; the shadow side of the face reads slightly cool while the lit side stays neutral

skin.pore_scale: at this framing the pore reads as fine textural grain rather than individual pores on the face; hands read at pore scale
skin.specular_zones: the T-zone is measurably brighter than the cheeks; the hand ridges catch specular from the sun
skin.subsurface: subsurface scattering reddens the ear rims and the fingertips where the sun grazes
skin.regional_variation: the neck reads finer than the forehead; the back of the hand reads coarser than the palm

render.palette_note: warm midtones from the sun with cool separation into the shadows
render.highlight_rolloff: gradual rolloff on the wardrobe brights without clipping
render.black_point: deepest shadow near 7 percent luminance rather than pure black
render.grain: fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 200

frame.composition: subject slightly camera-left of centre with the environment opening on the camera-right; feet inside the frame with two percent margin below the sole
frame.headroom: moderate headroom, roughly 6 percent of frame height above the crown

environment.sky_fill: open sky dome at 8500K, two stops under the sun, giving the shadow side a cool bias
environment.atmospheric_perspective: the environment 10 metres out and beyond drops in contrast and saturation, separating without depending on aperture alone
contact_points: under each foot against the ground

imperfection_budget.specific: a hem is caught by the wind and lifts a few centimetres from vertical
the subject's weight shifted onto the back foot and the shoulder line sits marginally off horizontal

defaults.capture_reality: A single frame from a working editorial shoot in daylight
avoid: flare without a sun in the angle of incidence

example_answers.meta.user_request: editorial de campanha em corpo inteiro numa rua de centro urbano ao meio-dia
example_answers.subject.description: A 27-year-old woman with warm mid-brown skin, dark eyes and long straight black hair pulled loosely back, about 1.72 metres tall with a lean build
subject.asymmetries: the right eyebrow sits marginally higher than the left
the weight rests on the right foot with the left hip dropped and the left shoulder marginally lower
subject.preserved_marks: a 3mm mole above the left corner of the mouth
a faint diagonal scar of 8mm along the top of the right forearm
capillary flush on the knuckles from the walk
example_answers.subject.expression: the mouth is closed and neutral, the chin down a few degrees, the eyes engaged with the camera
example_answers.wardrobe.0.garment: a caramel wool double-breasted overcoat left open over a plain black cotton T-shirt and straight indigo denim, worn brown leather ankle boots
example_answers.environment.description: a low-traffic side street with pale limestone façades on both sides, storefronts blurred out at 15 metres, no pedestrians in the near frame
